title: It's a Crime, Mr. Collins
paragraphs: A detective series about private investigator Greg Collins, with many of his cases narrated from the perspective of his wife, Gail, as the couple encounters crime at home and while traveling.

Australian Crawford Productions version, distinct from the lost 1956-57 American Mutual series. Frozen GRH subset contains nine Keith Eden/Mary Disney episodes from May 1957 through January 1958. Titles use a color motif; dates align with the maintained Australian episode log.
GRH documents the program through Australian Crawford Productions run (March 4, 1957 to 1958).
Among the most extensively documented contributors in the GRH holdings are Keith Eden (performer on 9 recordings) and Mary Disney (performer on 9 recordings).

Its indexed subjects and listening characteristics include private detective investigation, married detective partnership, color-title mystery convention, Australian radio syndication, murder investigation, and jealousy and romantic complications.
GRH also places the series in documented historical contexts including Australian Crawford Productions Mr Collins run and Distinct from lost American Mutual production.
